Flight · Romania

Two aerial targets enter Romania off Tulcea; one later destroyed near Reni

14 October 2026 · Off northeastern Tulcea · 20:04 incursions

Two radar-confirmed entries; one radar contact lost over sea, one target later destroyed in Ukraine

Two aerial targets entered Romanian airspace over the Black Sea at 20:04 on 14 October 2026, according to the Defence Ministry. Contact with one was lost over the sea; the other left at 20:13 toward Vâlcove and was later destroyed by Ukrainian air defence near Reni.

Two Spanish F-18s launched. Warnings were issued for Tulcea at 20:02 and eastern Galați at 20:33; the all-clear came at 21:14. The targets’ models and operators remain unresolved.

Both targets are retained in one timed incursion record. Radar loss does not prove a crash or a strike on YARA J, whose separate incident is recorded as N086. A connection remains unproven, and the records should not be interpreted as a verified count of distinct drones.
